jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Modulai works with fish, trains, clothes, money, pets, office spaces, sound sensors and much more. If there is data, we do ML (Machine Learning) on it. 
Our team consists of devoted ML engineers with strong track records from some of Sweden’s most successful startups. We work on project basis and take end-to-end responsibility. We love ML and we think that the best way for us to expand our knowledge is to be exposed to a diversified set of challenging and fun projects. 
MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER 
As a member of the ML-team you will be working with a broad range of problems with one common denominator – ML will be the key ingredient. The projects could be external as well as internal – and in all cases – delivery is central. 
You will have to analyze the problem at hand, come up with a solution strategy and execute on it. This typically entails gaining an in-depth understanding of the challenge, understanding the available data and then re-formulating it as a ML problem. It requires openness, creativity and an eagerness to learn new methodology and exploring new terrains. 
We frequently attack these problems as a team, meaning that you will have to be able to clearly explain your reasoning and code in order to engage the rest of us. 


Our Stack
Python / R – standard open-source libraries
Scikit-learn and various specialized Python and R ML libraries
Large Language Model (LLM) frameworks such as LangChain/LlamaIndex, LangGraph, CrewAI
Cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure
CI/CD: DVC, Github Actions, Sagemaker/VertexAI/AzureML,
Relational database management systems
MLOps and LLMOps tools for model deployment and monitoring.
Software engineering best practices, including testing, version control (Git), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Orchestration: Airflow, AWS Step functions, etc Engineering/LLM/deployment: Kubernetes, docker, terraform



Responsibilities
Analyzing and planning problems, solutions, and delivery with stakeholder managment, and communication with client
Preprocessing, feature engineering, and dataset creation
ML and LLM model development, fine-tuning, and evaluation
Validation of results and model interpretability
Building and optimizing data pipelines and ML/LLM infrastructure
Developing APIs and integrating ML models into production systems
Ensuring scalability, monitoring, and performance optimization of deployed models



Background & Skills
MSc or Ph.D. in a quantitative field
Excellent understanding of a broad set of ML and deep learning algorithms, including LLMs
Strong software development skills in Python and experience with software engineering best practices
Experience deploying ML and LLM models into production environments
A passion for lean, clean, and maintainable code
The desire to grow and to share insights with others



Helpful Knowledge
Deep learning frameworks and transformer-based architectures
LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Data pipelining and ML/LLM infrastructure best practices
DevOps experience, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and serverless architectures
Experience with vector databases e.g (Pinecode, redis, and ElasticSearch) for LLM applications



About Team Modulai
At Modulai we focus 100% on solving problems with machine learning (ML). We work in teams on a project basis. We work for clients, as part of the core team in startups where we have long-time engagement as well for large enterprises transforming ways of working.
Learning and teamwork are central to how we work. Everyone in the team is or will soon be a full-stack ML engineer capable of scoping and developing end-to-end ML solutions. You should be able to do end-to-end machine learning products by yourself but actually, never do it because we always work in teams. If there is data, we will do ML on it!
Apply here: https://modulai.teamtailor.com/

jobs.title: MLOps Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
One of Nordic Investin’s partner companies is looking for an MLOps Platform Engineer, with Nordic Investin leading the recruitment process. You want data scientists to experiment freely while production models remain reproducible, observable and governable.
The partner is scaling machine learning across several teams and needs a common platform for training, deployment and monitoring. You will build the paved paths that connect experiments with reliable services.
The partner wants data and AI work that can be operated, explained and improved after launch. Provenance, quality, access and evaluation belong in the solution from the beginning.
How you will work
You will work with engineers, analysts and domain specialists who look at the same information from different angles. The partner expects assumptions, datasets and evaluation methods to be visible. Solutions should be designed for repeatable delivery, monitored use and responsible change after deployment.
As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work.
What you will do
Create reusable training and inference infrastructure.


Automate model packaging, validation and deployment.


Build feature, registry and experiment tracking integrations.


Implement monitoring for data and model behaviour.


Manage compute, access and cost controls.


Support teams adopting the platform through examples and documentation.

What you will bring
Production platform, DevOps or machine learning engineering experience.


Strong Python and cloud infrastructure knowledge.


Containers, Kubernetes and CI CD.


Experience with ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow or managed cloud services.


Infrastructure as code and observability skills.


Ability to design for both researchers and operators.

Experience that would add value
GPU workload orchestration.


Feature stores and online inference.


Governance in healthcare, finance or public services.

A background that can succeed here
Your route may be from platform engineering into machine learning or from data science into production systems. We value people who understand both experimentation speed and operational control.
What makes the opportunity interesting
The partner offers a platform at the point where good foundations will have lasting influence. You will multiply the effectiveness of several ML teams and see your work reflected in faster, safer releases.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.
The recruitment conversation
During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
SCRL is a mobile-first design platform built for social media and used by millions of creators worldwide.
We're a team based in central Stockholm, working closely across functions with a shared commitment to quality, clarity, and craft.


The role
This is a role with real impact and plenty of room to grow. You'll join the data team and work on the infrastructure that powers SCRL's analytics, forecasting, and AI-driven product features — from event ingestion all the way to the data services our apps rely on.
We're open to a range of experience levels. If you're earlier in your career, you'll learn alongside experienced data and engineering teammates and grow into broader ownership of the systems you build. If you come in with more experience, you'll have the opportunity to shape the direction of our data infrastructure and raise the bar for what we build next.
Either way, you'll work on real systems with real users — and you'll have the freedom to do the best work of your career.


What you will do
Data pipelines & infrastructure
Contribute to our ETL across the stack, helping make it easier to use, more reliable, and clearer when something goes wrong.
Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from the services we rely on (RevenueCat, Firebase Analytics, attribution providers, ad networks, and others) via API and event streaming.
Work in our BigQuery warehouse — schema design, Terraform-managed infrastructure, partitioning, and query optimization for a dataset that serves millions of users.
Develop and maintain GCP Cloud Functions and Cloud Run services for event processing, transformations, and scheduled jobs.
Help evolve our internal Python framework for shared models, utilities, and pipeline components used across the data codebase.

Analytics & modeling support
Bring data scientists' and analysts' models into production so they can be consumed reliably by the apps, backend services, and internal tools.
Build and maintain the data services that power product features such as template recommendations and personalization.
Support subscription analytics infrastructure: cohorting, LTV, ROAS, retention, and forecasting pipelines across iOS and Android.
Develop internal libraries and shared SQL/Python primitives for app metrics calculation, used by the broader team.

Data quality, observability & craft
Help implement monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks so we catch issues before stakeholders do.
Contribute to lineage and documentation that makes the warehouse navigable for everyone who uses it.
Support GDPR-compliant data handling, including consent propagation, retention policies, and deletion across systems.
Help maintain consistency of event schemas and metric definitions across web and mobile platforms.
Be a contributor to — and over time a champion of — data culture across the company.

You should have
Technical foundations
Languages: Solid proficiency in Python and SQL. Comfort with TypeScript/NodeJS or similar for service work is a plus, not a requirement.
Warehousing: Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses, ideally BigQuery — or strong fundamentals you're ready to transfer.
Pipelines: Some experience building or contributing to production data pipelines, from ingestion through transformation to serving.
Cloud infrastructure: Exposure to GCP (or AWS/Azure) is a strong plus. Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) is welcome but can be learned on the job.

Mindset & approach
Curiosity and care for craft: You take pride in the quality of what you ship and want to keep getting better at it.
Data pipelines owner mindset: You're interested in fully managing data flows from ingestion to processing, even if you haven't done it end-to-end yet.
Quality and pragmatism: You can work at a healthy pace without compromising the things that matter — clarity, reliability, and correctness.
Can-do attitude: Self-motivated problem solver with an eye for detail and an internal drive for excellence.

Product & business understanding
Subscription apps: Experience with or strong interest in subscription-based app businesses and freemium models.
Cross-platform thinking: Interest in the complexities of unifying data across web, iOS, and Android.
Analytics-driven approach: Comfortable working closely with analysts and data scientists, and wanting the data layer you build to support the insights the business needs.

Collaboration & communication
Team player: You work closely and generously with analysts, data scientists, backend, and mobile engineers.
Clear communication: You can explain what you're working on in a way that makes sense to teammates who don't share your technical background.

We offer
High-impact role: You'll work on the data platform that powers analytics, forecasting, and AI features for millions of users.
Room to grow: Take ownership of systems from early on, with support from experienced teammates and the space to develop into broader scope over time.
Startup environment: Fast-paced decision making with direct impact on product direction.
Strong team: Work alongside experienced data and engineering professionals in central Stockholm.
Competitive package: Market-rate salary with opportunities for professional development.
Creative culture: Be part of a profitable company that values creativity and user experience.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.


Joining Legora means three things.
We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.


We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
What you’ll be doing
Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a traditional box. It's part legal ops, part product specialist, part solutions architect, and part client whisperer. If you enjoy roles that stay static, this probably isn't it. Your mission is to help our clients, some of the most prestigious law firms in the world, get the absolute most out of our platform.
Some of what you'll be up to:
Acting as a thought partner to law firm partners, associates, and innovation teams - building trusted relationships, addressing tricky pain points, and identifying high-value opportunities for them to scale their use of Legora across practice groups.


Working together with Go To Market and Engagement in taking full ownership of firm relationships - from running pilots with key practice areas, to onboarding new associates and partners, and ultimately guiding full-firm adoption across global law firms.
Be the voice of law firm users inside Legora - sharing insights from M&A teams, litigation departments, and other practice groups that directly inform product development, roadmap priorities, and strategic direction.
Delivering clear, confident product demos and training that bring the power of our platform to life - whether you're presenting to a single practice group or rolling out firm-wide.
Documenting best practices from leading firms, contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, and help shape how we grow this function globally.
Confidently helping law firms navigate one of the biggest shifts in how legal services are delivered - from evaluating the ROI and competitive advantage of AI to clearly mapping how AI will impact different practice areas, from corporate to disputes.

What you bring
You come from the world of Big Law; but you've never been content with how things have always been done. You may have trained and practised at a top-tier law firm, experiencing first-hand the pressures of billable hours, client demands, and operational inefficiencies. Perhaps you've moved into legal innovation, knowledge management, or legal tech within a firm. Maybe you've even left private practice to disrupt the status quo through a legal tech company, or ventures of your own. Either way, you know how law firms think, work, and (sometimes) struggle and you're ready to help them level up with technology.
You'll thrive in this role if you:
Have a background in law, with experience at a top-tier law firm - ideally across multiple practice areas or with exposure to firm-wide initiatives.


Are tech-curious and product-savvy. Not necessarily a coder, but passionate about navigating technical conversations, especially around things like generative AI, technology implementation, innovation and productivity.
Communicate clearly and confidently with diverse stakeholders, from senior partners to graduate trainees, and from lawyers to engineers. I.e. translating across disciplines is second nature to you.
Bring structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity; and enjoy being the calm, credible presence in a fast-moving environment.
Understand how to evaluate and improve existing processes as a direct result of new and emerging technologies - whether that's streamlining due diligence, contract review, or legal research.
Are proactive, self-directed, and comfortable juggling multiple firm relationships at once.
Care deeply about quality, but don't get stuck in perfectionism - you get things done, and you make them better over time.
Understand the commercial realities of law firm life: billing pressures, client expectations, competitive positioning, and the delicate balance between innovation and risk management.

We're a fast-growing company with bold ambitions, so you'll be joining at a time when things are moving quickly - in the best possible way. You'll have a lot of autonomy, a lot of responsibility, and the chance to genuinely shape how this function evolves. Everyone here has a founder-mentality.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar. 
 Do you want to help bridge the gap between today and the future - and play a key role in driving Saab's digital transformation? It's no longer only about how fast Saab's products can fly, how deep they can dive or how far they can reach. It's also about how fast they can adapt - always further, forever beyond. Saab is entering a new era of software transformation, where speed, intelligent use of data and systems that evolve as fast as the world changes are essential. 
In this transformation, Common Tech and Product Tech are key enablers. We build the shared platforms and components and enable Saab's product teams to move faster, innovate more freely and shorten the time from need to real‑world capability.
Together, we bridge the gap between current engineering practices and the capabilities required for Saab's digital transformation - redefining how we build software, use data and deliver systems at speed.


Your role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner with product teams across Saab to solve complex technical challenges and accelerate innovation. You will build solutions, introduce new technologies and platforms, and help teams successfully adopt modern engineering practices.
The role combines hands-on software engineering with technical leadership, enabling both technology and people to move forward. This is not a traditional developer role. It's a role for curious engineers who thrive in new environments, enjoy variety, and are motivated by creating real impact.
What you'll do
Work hands-on with complex technical challenges across different product areas
Partner with product teams to understand their needs and turn them into scalable technical solutions
Build and improve shared platforms, tools, and components that enable reuse across Saab
Explore and apply technologies such as AI, cloud, edge computing, and real-time systems
Enable teams to adopt and successfully apply modern technologies, platforms, and engineering practices in real product environments
Help establish new ways of working that increase speed, quality, and collaboration
Turn ambiguous challenges into clear, practical solutions
Influence technical direction and long-term platform strategy


Your profile


You enjoy working where technology, innovation, and real-world impact meet. You're someone who likes understanding complex systems, exploring new possibilities, and turning ideas into practical solutions. You combine strong engineering skills with curiosity and a pragmatic mindset. While your background may be in software engineering, systems engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, what matters most is your ability to solve complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and help others move forward.
You are comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and balancing hands-on engineering with enabling long-term success for teams and products.
What you'll bring
We're looking for engineers who have built a solid foundation through experience and are ready to apply it across a variety of technical challenges.
You likely have:
Several years of experience working with software or systems engineering in complex product or technology environments
Experience designing, building, or evolving technical solutions that are used by others
Familiarity with modern engineering practices such as cloud technologies, CI/CD, automation, platform engineering, or distributed systems 
An interest in how AI, data, and emerging technologies can create practical value
The ability to break down complex problems and turn uncertainty into clear direction
Strong collaboration skills and an eagerness to learn from and share knowledge with others

It's a bonus if you have experience with:
Cloud-native platforms and infrastructure
AI/ML applications in real-world products
Platform engineering and reusable building blocks
Systems architecture and technical leadership
Real-time, safety-critical, or highly regulated environments

We know that great engineers bring different experiences and perspectives. If this role excites you, but you don't meet every single qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Your potential, curiosity, and ability to learn are just as important as any individual technology or tool.
This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.


What you will be part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At XXL, we're on a mission to create the best shopping experience for sports and outdoor enthusiasts across the Nordics. Behind every great customer experience is a strong technology team, and we're looking for a Software Engineer who wants to help us build and improve the digital solutions that power XXL.
As part of our in-house IT team, you'll work across the entire technology stack, developing everything from customer-facing e-commerce solutions to internal applications, integrations and automation. This is an opportunity to work with modern technologies, influence technical decisions and contribute to scalable solutions that make a real impact across the business.
About the role
As a Software Engineer, you'll be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving both frontend and backend solutions across XXL's digital platforms.
Working closely with developers, architects and business stakeholders, you'll contribute to everything from new features and integrations to infrastructure improvements and long-term technical development. We value developers who are curious, pragmatic and passionate about building robust, secure and scalable solutions.
What you'll be doing
As part of the development team, you'll:

Develop new functionality across frontend, backend, infrastructure and integrations


Improve and maintain our e-commerce platform and internal applications


Build, maintain and optimise APIs and integrations between different systems


Contribute to architecture discussions and technical decision-making


Improve performance, scalability, security and cost efficiency across our platforms


Design and maintain event-driven integrations, scheduled jobs, queue-based processing and synchronous/asynchronous system flows


Debug and monitor distributed systems using logs, metrics and monitoring tools


Work with CI/CD pipelines, deployments and multiple development environments


Reduce technical debt and continuously improve code quality and maintainability


Collaborate with the development team to continuously improve ways of working and engineering best practices


Who we're looking for
We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building high-quality solutions that last.
You likely have:

At least 3 years of experience in a similar Software Engineer role


Experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript development


Strong knowledge of React and Node.js


Experience building frontend and backend applications using modern web technologies


Experience working with REST APIs, integrations and API contracts


Experience with serverless architectures and cloud-based solutions


Good understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing


Experience working with NoSQL databases


Experience with Git, code reviews and collaborative software development


Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployment processes


Knowledge of application security, authentication, authorization and IAM


You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. Swedish or Norwegian language skills are a plus


It's an advantage if you also have experience with:

Next.js


AWS services such as DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, ECS, API Gateway, Cognito or CloudFront


Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation/CDK)


GraphQL


Cypress or Playwright


Web performance optimisation


CSS, SASS, component libraries and Figma


AI tools, automation and emerging technologies


E-commerce platforms and digital retail


Who you are
We believe you'll thrive in this role if you are:

Curious and eager to learn new technologies.


Passionate about creating high-quality software.


A proactive problem solver who enjoys taking initiative.


Pragmatic and able to balance technical quality with business value.


A collaborative team player who enjoys sharing knowledge.


Structured and quality-focused, with a long-term mindset.


Motivated by continuous improvement and modern ways of working.


Why join XXL?
At XXL, technology is an important part of our future. We develop many of our digital solutions in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both technology choices and ways of working.
You'll become part of a collaborative team where knowledge sharing, continuous learning and innovation are highly valued. We offer exciting technical challenges, modern technologies and the opportunity to contribute to solutions used by millions of customers across the Nordics.
If you're looking for a role where you can combine hands-on development with real business impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Practical information
Location: HQ Stockholm
We've replaced the traditional cover letter with a few screening questions, and you'll simply need to upload your CV as part of your application.
Please note that we only process applications submitted through our online application system.
If you have any questions about the role, please contact Peter Skogsberg, IT Development Manager, Peter.Skogsberg@xxl.se / +46 7024 18527
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Analytiker/Data Scientist inom bidragsbrott till Uppsala
jobs.description:
Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför sätter vi oss in i varje ärende, följer lagar och regler, informerar och vägleder, bryr oss och visar omtanke. Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar. Välkommen till Försäkringskassan.
Hos oss får du ett varierande och avancerat arbete i en trevlig arbetsmiljö, med goda möjligheter till balans mellan arbete och fritid. Om du också värdesätter ett välfungerande arbete med dina kollegor och vill bli en del av ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag, så kan detta vara tjänsten för dig.
Försäkringskassan har kommit långt i sin tillämpning av analys och AI i syfte att motverka bidragsbrott och felaktiga utbetalningar. Vi arbetar med stora mängder interna och externa data samlat på ett omfattande och strukturerat data warehouse. Vårt datalager är bland de största i Norden.
Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med riskvärdering och programmering. Främst handlar det om att ta fram urval till kontroll men vi arbetar även med att automatisera och förbättra myndighetens handläggning. Du bör ha arbetslivserfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data samt kombinera data från olika källor.
Arbetsuppgifterna innebär bl.a. att ta fram, vidareutveckla och förvalta urval, expertsystem och utredningsstöd i form av webapplikationer tillsammans med t.ex. verksamhetsspecialister och IT. Du kommer jobba främst i SAS EG (low-code) och SAS Viya. För att kunna ha en hög förvaltningsbarhet på våra produkter är det viktigt att arbetet utförs enligt vår arbetsprocess, där man följer den standard och de arbetsrutiner som vi har tagit fram. Detta inkluderar även dokumentation av produkten. Arbetet är omväxlande och du kommer i kontakt med stora delar av Försäkringskassans verksamhet.
Tjänsten innebär att du hanterar sekretessbelagda uppgifter vilket ställer höga krav på rätt hantering. Därför är det viktigt att du som ska arbeta hos oss har högt säkerhetsmedvetande.
Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar.
Vi söker dig som
har högskolexamen inom matematik, statistik, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, eller annan utbildning som vi bedömer som likvärdig som t.ex. en ingenjörsutbildning
har god erfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data
har erfarenhet av analysarbete med kvantitativa metoder
har goda kunskaper i relevanta analysmetoder och programmeringsspråk som exempelvis SAS och SQL
agerar på eget initiativ och tar ansvar för att nå goda resultat
har ett systematiskt och noggrant arbetssätt
kan förstå och analysera komplexa frågor
samarbetar effektivt med andra för att nå gemensamma mål
har god kommunikativ förmåga.

Det är meriterande om du:
har erfarenhet av avancerad dataanalys
har erfarenhet från arbete inom socialförsäkringen eller annan myndighet
har mycket god erfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data från Försäkringskassans datalager
har erfarenhet av att använda SAS EG, SAS EM, SAS STP eller motsvarande i SAS Viya.

Övrigt
En tjänst, tillsvidare, heltid, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan bli aktuellt. Vissa anställningar hos oss innebär deltagande i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet. För att bli anställd i en sådan tjänst krävs godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).
I enlighet med Försäkringskassans riktlinje för säkerhet genomförs bakgrundskontroller i denna rekrytering. Möjlighet till distansarbete finns om arbetet tillåter. I den här rekryteringen kan arbetspsykologiska test och arbetsprov användas som en del i urvalsarbetet. Placeringsort: Stockholm eller Uppsala.
Vill du veta mer om Försäkringskassan som arbetsgivare? Besök fk.se/jobbahososs
Kontaktpersoner
Chef: Pål Wilkens 010-116 22 35 (för frågor om tjänsten). HR-specialist: Fanny Secher, mailto:fanny.secher@fk.se (för frågor om rekryteringsprocessen). ST: Henrik Lindholm 010-116 92 35, Saco-S: Annika Linell 010-114 79 54, Seko: Johanna Grundström 010-115 30 44.
Ansökan
Välkommen med din ansökan senast 28 september 2026. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar, du får istället besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Ladda upp dina examensbevis, betyg och intyg i samband med din ansökan.
Har du skyddade personuppgifter eller ingen tillgång till bank-id kontaktar du den HR-specialist som finns namngiven i annonsen via telefon så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.
 
Vi ska i allt vi gör, agera med utgångspunkt i principen om alla människors lika värde, rättssäkerhet och med god service.

jobs.title: Production Test Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role 
Neko Health is building a new kind of health service: one that catches disease early, before people feel unwell. Our scanners are complex medical devices, and the quality of how we test them in production directly affects what we can tell patients about their health. 
Right now, manufacturing test at Neko Health does not have a dedicated owner. Tests are developed in R&D but there is no clear handover path into production, no single person responsible for keeping them current, and no structured way to capture and trace test results across our product lines. This role exists to change that. 
We are looking for a Manufacturing Test Engineer to build that foundation: owning all tests in production, creating a clear process for R&D to hand tests over into manufacturing, writing the requirements that underpin each test, and developing the traceability that lets us act on test data. You will also work with R&D on new tests as our products evolve. 
This is a role with real scope and real impact. You will not be handed a fully defined process -- you will build it, and what you create will still be running as production scales. 
What You Will Do 
Own and maintain all tests in production 
Manufacturing test at Neko Health currently has no dedicated owner. You will take on that responsibility: keeping tests current as products change, ensuring every test has a clear requirement behind it, and acting as the person R&D can hand a test to when it is ready for production. You will create the structure that makes that handover reliable and repeatable. 
Write and own test requirements 
You will ensure every test in manufacturing has a clear, approved specification: what is being tested, what the pass/fail criteria are, what equipment is needed, and what the risk rationale is. You will write these requirements, keep them maintained, and manage changes through our quality system. 
Develop new tests with R&D 
When we develop new products or make significant changes to existing ones, you will work with R&D to turn test concepts into production-ready tests: defined criteria, the right equipment, clear operator instructions, and validated before handover to the floor. 
Build traceability into manufacturing test 
We are investing in end-to-end traceability across production. You will help design and implement how test results are structured, reported, and pushed to our MES system. This involves both the specification work and the practical implementation -- writing scripts or integrations to make data flow reliably from test stations to our quality records. 
Improve what we already have 
You will analyse test failure trends and identify where our current tests can be stronger. Whether that is closing a coverage gap, tightening a criterion, or improving how test data is captured and reported, you will drive the improvement rather than wait for someone to flag it. 
Support the production team 
You will be a go-to resource for production engineers and operators when test-related issues come up: deviations, non-conformances, or questions about whether a result is valid. You will also contribute to training and documentation so that the team can run tests consistently. 
What We Are Looking For 
We care more about how you think and work than about a specific background. The things that matter most for this role: 
You write documentation that other people can actually use -- clear, structured, and with a clear requirement behind every decision. 
You have worked with test in a manufacturing or hardware context and understand what makes a test production-ready, not just technically correct. 
You can translate between engineering intent and operational reality: what R&D needs to verify and what an operator can reliably do on a station. 
You are comfortable working across both the technical and the process side -- scripting a data integration and writing the work instruction for it. 
You are comfortable with ambiguity and with building things that do not fully exist yet. 
You follow through: if you identify a gap, you close it. 



Background 
You will likely have experience in test engineering, quality engineering, or manufacturing engineering in a hardware product company. You do not need to have worked in medical devices. What matters is that you have written formal test requirements, worked close to production, and collaborated with engineering teams on test development. 


How We Work 
At Neko Health we actively use AI in our day-to-day work -- for documentation, analysis, and problem-solving -- and we expect the same from everyone who joins. We are not looking for people who use AI occasionally; we are looking for people who have figured out where it genuinely helps and have made it part of how they work. In this role that might mean using it to draft test requirements, analyse test failure patterns, or accelerate integration work -- and knowing when to rely on engineering judgment instead. 


Why Neko Health 
We are at an early and important stage: scaling production of medical devices that genuinely improve how disease is detected. The work you do here will be visible, will matter, and will grow in scope as the company grows. 
You will work in Stockholm with a small, technically strong team. The role is broad by design -- we are not looking for someone to fit into a narrow lane.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Plant Engineering · Stockholm
Blykalla is scaling quickly to industrialize our small modular reactor (SMR) concept. If you are passionate about nuclear technology and want to make a meaningful impact, join us.
What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company developing lead-cooled small modular reactors. Our compact reactor design combines high safety with a simple, cost-effective and scalable approach to delivering clean, reliable baseload energy that complements solar and wind power.
The role
As Reliability Engineer, you will own reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) engineering for Blykalla’s SEALER-55 lead-cooled fast reactor (LFR). You will work across assigned plant areas, systems and work packages within Plant Engineering, delivering quantitative reliability analysis that supports the plant design and the probabilistic safety assessment (PSA).
You will establish and apply Blykalla’s RAM, FMEA and FMECA framework, ensuring reliability and availability targets are translated into design, redundancy, sparing, testing and maintenance requirements. You will assess how design and maintenance decisions affect plant availability and lifecycle performance, and support the project from design through procurement, construction and handover to commissioning and operations.
What you’ll do
RAM engineering and modelling
Establish and maintain RAM, FMEA and FMECA methods, templates, criticality criteria, data sources and analysis assumptions.
Define reliability design bases, RAM targets, modelling methodology and requirements for assigned areas.
Build and maintain reliability block diagrams, fault trees and availability models, including Markov or Monte-Carlo simulations.
Work in RiskSpectrum for fault-tree and PSA-aligned modelling, alongside relevant RAM tools such as ReliaSoft, Isograph, GRIF or Maros/Taro.
Flow reliability, availability and maintainability requirements into specifications, data sheets and supplier packages.

Analysis and technical input
Perform and review RAM studies, FMEA/FMECA, reliability-centred maintenance analyses, criticality ranking, spares and logistics modelling, and lost-production analyses.
Quantify the impact of redundancy, maintenance strategies, test intervals and sparing on availability and lifecycle performance.
Develop reliability data and failure-rate estimates using sources such as ISO 14224 and OREDA, including Weibull/life-data analysis and common-cause assumptions.
Provide component failure data, maintenance assumptions and common-cause inputs to the PSA and safety case.

Interfaces, suppliers and delivery
Coordinate with process, mechanical, rotating equipment, electrical, I&C, civil and structural, layout, safety and licensing, and operations and maintenance teams.
Identify and resolve issues related to single points of failure, common-cause vulnerabilities, testability, maintainability and maintenance access.
Set and review RAM requirements for RFQs and supplier packages, including reliability data, FMECA and reliability demonstration requirements.
Contribute to estimates, schedules, risk reviews, design reviews, RFIs, site queries and change requests, including assessment of availability impacts.

Capability building
Mentor engineers and improve reliability methods, templates, checklists and data libraries.
Help build a scalable reliability engineering capability that supports Blykalla’s plant-as-a-product mindset, modular design and DfMA approach.

Typical deliverables
Reliability design bases and RAM targets; reliability block diagrams, fault trees and availability models; RAM study reports; FMEA/FMECA and criticality registers; RCM analyses; reliability data libraries; PSA inputs; supplier review comments; interface registers; and change-control or handover inputs.
Who you are
You have:
At least 6 years of hands-on experience in reliability or RAM engineering, including nuclear experience and RAM/PSA-support analysis for nuclear plants or systems.
Experience leading reliability engineering across a major plant area, full project or several complex work packages.
Strong quantitative RAM modelling skills and practical experience with RiskSpectrum.
Knowledge of relevant reliability and dependability standards, including IEC 60300, IEC 61078, IEC 61025, IEC 61165, IEC 61649 and IEC 60812.
Familiarity with ISO 14224, OREDA, nuclear reliability data, and relevant IAEA, regulatory and PSA guidance such as US NRC/NUREG and Swedish SSM guidance.
The ability to work across technical disciplines, manage ambiguity and balance technical rigour with practical delivery.
A collaborative, transparent and solution-oriented approach, with an interest in coaching others and strengthening the discipline.

What we offer
You will join a diverse and highly motivated Plant Engineering team and report to the Manager of Plant Engineering. This is an opportunity to help shape the reliability approach for a first-of-a-kind reactor programme and contribute directly to the future of clean nuclear energy.
Location: Stockholm


Salary range: SEK 60,000–76,000 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.
Reference & background checks
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates and may conduct reference checks where relevant. We handle personal data in accordance with applicable data-protection regulations.
We do not accept applications via email and are not open to external recruitment-agency support.
Note on AI use: Blykalla may use AI for administrative support, such as note-taking, interview documentation and reporting. Every application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team, and AI does not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

Har en fullföljd Masterexamen (300 hp) inom ett relevant område för kvantitativ datahantering (t.ex. Data Science, Statistik, Nationalekonomi, Samhällsgeografi, Demografi, Statsvetenskap eller Stads- /Regionplanering).

Har goda kunskaper inom datahantering och analys samt praktisk erfarenhet av programmering i
Python (eller liknande språk) för datatvätt, analys och scripting.
Är flytande i engelska i både tal och skrift, samt har god förståelse för minst ett skandinaviskt språk (svenska, danska eller norska), då du kommer att ta emot underlag och kommunicera i nordisk kontext.

Det är meriterande om du
Har erfarenhet av koordinering, projektledning eller att agera mentor/stöd för juniora kollegor.

Som person är du
För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och självständig person. Du är en hjälpsam lagspelare som tycker om att stötta andra och förklara komplexa data på ett enkelt sätt. Då teamet är nystartat trivs du i en miljö där allt inte är helt fastställt ännu, utan du ser möjligheter i att skapa nya rutiner och ta egna initiativ. För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:
Målmedveten
Nyfiken
Hjälpsam
Förändringsbenägen

Vår rekryteringsprocess
Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Engineer
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten och kunden
Vill du arbeta i teknikens framkant och bidra till att utveckla nästa generations mjukvaruplattformar, AI-lösningar och moderna utvecklingsmiljöer? Nu söker vi en ingenjör till ett långsiktigt uppdrag hos ett ledande teknikföretag inom försvarsindustrin.
Du blir en del av en organisation som driver digital transformation genom att utveckla gemensamma plattformar, arbetssätt och tekniska förmågor som används brett i verksamheten. Rollen skiljer sig från den traditionella systemingenjörsrollen och kombinerar systemförståelse, arkitektur och praktiskt utvecklingsarbete med förändringsledning och nära samarbete med verksamheten.
Arbetet sker i kortare, intensiva projekt där du tillsammans med utvecklare, arkitekter och specialister hjälper olika delar av verksamheten att accelerera sin tekniska utveckling. Fokus ligger på att analysera komplexa system, identifiera lösningar som kan återanvändas och skapa förutsättningar för skalbara arbetssätt. När lösningen är etablerad lämnas ansvaret över till verksamheten, vilket innebär stor variation mellan uppdragen.
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

Utforma och vidareutveckla gemensamma mjukvaruplattformar och tekniska lösningar.


Analysera systembeteenden, arkitektur och prestanda för att identifiera förbättrings- och återanvändningsmöjligheter.


Arbeta med moderna tekniker inom AI, molnlösningar, distribuerade system och realtidsmiljöer.


Samarbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter, systemingenjörer och verksamhet för att omsätta tekniska behov till hållbara lösningar.


Bidra till plattformsstrategi, teknisk riktning och etablering av best practice.


Vara en drivande kraft i den digitala transformationen genom att stötta team i nya arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar.


Här erbjuds du en varierad roll där du får kombinera tekniskt djup med ett helhetsperspektiv. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste tekniken, påverka hur framtidens utvecklingsmiljöer utformas och bidra till en organisation där innovation, samarbete och kontinuerligt lärande står i fokus.
Din kompetens
Vi söker dig som har:

Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplexa tekniska system.


Erfarenhet av programmering, oavsett programmeringsspråk.


Praktisk erfarenhet av att använda AI för att analysera eller förbättra tekniska system.


Förmåga att analysera systembeteende, arkitektur och samspelet mellan olika system.


God analytisk förmåga och erfarenhet av problemlösning i tekniska miljöer.


Goda kunskaper i engelska.


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av distribuerade system, molnplattformar eller realtidsmiljöer. Även erfarenhet av plattformsutveckling, teknisk arkitektur eller säkerhetskritiska system med höga krav på tillförlitlighet ses som ett plus.
Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta i miljöer där teknik, människor och förändring möts. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende, samarbetar naturligt över teamgränser och kan förklara komplexa tekniska sammanhang på ett pedagogiskt sätt. Du motiveras av att hjälpa andra att utvecklas, ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder och har ett genuint intresse för moderna tekniker och arbetssätt. Rollen passar dig som både uppskattar att arbeta hands-on och samtidigt har förmågan att se helheten och skapa lösningar som kan skalas och återanvändas i flera delar av verksamheten.
Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. Denna tjänst innebär krav på svenskt medborgarskap. 
Övrigt
Lön: Fast månadslön
Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare
Start: Omgående med hänsyn tagen till din eventuella uppsägningstid
Placeringsort: Solna, Stockholm
Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut, skicka din ansökan redan idag!
Om oss
Procruitment är Sveriges enda karriärbyrå inom IT, tech och engineering som genom proaktiv rekrytering förenar attraktiva arbetsgivare med människor som delar samma mål och ambitioner. Oavsett om du är en erfaren ledare eller om du ska ta ditt första steg ut i karriären hjälper vi dig att nå dina karriärmål - samtidigt som vi bryr oss om dig, din resa och att du mår bra längs vägen.
Procruitment är stolta vinnare av Recruitment Awards och är utsedda till Årets Rekryteringsföretag och Årets Raket samt Gasellföretag 2024 av Dagens Industri.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Som Product Engineer blir du en del av ett internationellt produktbolag som utvecklar avancerade mjukvarulösningar för datadrivna beslut inom retail och supply chain. Här blir du en del av ett team som hjälper utvecklingsorganisationen att arbeta smartare genom att driva förbättringar, utveckla AI-drivna arbetssätt och skapa lösningar som gör skillnad för både kollegor och kunder.
OM TJÄNSTEN:
I rollen som Product Engineer blir du en del av ett litet team med stor påverkan på hur organisationen arbetar. Rollen passar dig som motiveras av att lösa problem, driva förändring och omsätta idéer till konkreta förbättringar.
Du arbetar nära utvecklingsteam, Product Managers, Customer Success, Support och Operations för att effektivisera arbetssätt och utveckla lösningar som gör det enklare att bygga, lansera och vidareutveckla produkter. Det kan handla om att förbättra interna processer, utforska nya AI-verktyg, automatisera manuella arbetsflöden eller utveckla interna verktyg som skapar värde för hela organisationen.
Kulturen präglas av frihet under ansvar, korta beslutsvägar och hög tillit. Här får du stort eget ansvar samtidigt som du har erfarna kollegor att bolla idéer med. Nyfikenhet, initiativförmåga och viljan att ständigt förbättra uppskattas här, och du får goda möjligheter att påverka både arbetssätt och lösningar.
ARBETSUPPGIFTER:Identifiera förbättringsområden tillsammans med utveckling, produkt och andra verksamhetsfunktioner.
Driva förbättringsinitiativ från idé till implementation.
Identifiera möjligheter att använda AI och automatisering för att effektivisera arbetssätt.
Utveckla och förbättra interna verktyg, processer och arbetsmetoder.
Analysera data och användarfeedback för att identifiera möjligheter till förbättring.
Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Operations och Support.
VI SÖKER DIG SOM:Har en civilingenjörsexamen inom relevant område, exempelvis datateknik, industriell ekonomi, informationsteknik eller liknande.
Har erfarenhet från en teknisk, produktnära eller verksamhetsutvecklande roll där du drivit förbättringar och arbetat tvärfunktionellt.
Har ett stort intresse för teknik och är nyfiken på hur AI och automatisering kan förbättra arbetssätt och processer.
Trivs med att samarbeta med många olika intressenter och har en god kommunikativ förmåga.
Talar och skriver obehindrat på engelska.
Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet från SaaS, retail eller supply chain. 

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du är nyfiken, självgående och prestigelös. Du tycker om att sätta dig in i nya problem, ställer frågor och tar gärna egna initiativ i stället för att vänta på instruktioner.
Vidare ser vi att du motiveras av att skapa förbättringar, påverka hur människor arbetar och se dina idéer omsättas i praktiken. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som bygger förtroende och trivs med att samarbeta över teamgränser.
OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN:
Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du till en början blir anställd av Friday. Ambitionen från både kundens och vår sida är att du efter 9 månader blir direktanställd hos kunden.
ÖVRIG INFO:Omfattning: Heltid
Start: Enligt överenskommelse
Placering: Centrala Stockholm
Rekryteringsansvarig: Nora Sundberg

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen.
OM FRIDAY:
På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.
Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.
Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.
